image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, clinging to a mossy, textured surface (likely a rock or tree trunk). The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its limbs are splayed out, gripping the surface. The head is visible at the bottom of the frame, and the tail extends toward the top. The background consists of a rough, greenish-brown surface with some scattered debris like small leaves and twigs.
